concept: A dermatology clinic; condition guide and booking.
look: soft editorial clinical photography, diffused light, 50mm

shots.title: Hero
shots.prompt: Interior photograph of a dermatology clinic lobby in travertine and blush plaster in Dubai Healthcare City, calm, clean and welcoming, natural light, a sense of privacy and care, nobody present. Overall look: soft editorial clinical photography, diffused light, 50mm; colour palette of blush, warm white, travertine, sage. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Consultation
shots.prompt: Editorial photograph: a dermatologist examining a patient's cheek with a dermatoscope. Natural light, respectful and reassuring. Every person in the picture is a clearly different individual (age, build, skin tone, hair and clothing all vary) so no face is repeated; faces may be turned away or out of frame. Overall look: soft editorial clinical photography, diffused light, 50mm; colour palette of blush, warm white, travertine, sage. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
